nodes.label: Vitest hang caused by mupdf top-level await WASM init
nodes.rationale: Root cause closed as side effect of removing mupdf; lesson: re-test the blocked thing after an unrelated fix.
nodes.norm_label: vitest hang caused by mupdf top-level await wasm init

nodes.label: Catalog vision extraction: empty page returns items:[]
nodes.rationale: Catalog cover/TOC pages legitimately have zero products, unlike procurement docs which throw on empty; filling an underspecified detail inside an approved file is not a plan deviation.
nodes.norm_label: catalog vision extraction: empty page returns items:[]

nodes.label: p-limit removed in favour of in-house createLimit
nodes.rationale: ESM-only p-limit inside a CommonJS package was hidden via new Function import, which Vitest's module runner cannot execute; a workaround its own test runner cannot execute is an untested production path.
nodes.norm_label: p-limit removed in favour of in-house createlimit

nodes.label: createLimit (in-house concurrency limiter)
nodes.rationale: ~30-line replacement for pLimit(n)/limit(fn); crawl.spec.ts guard fails if new Function or ESM-only import is reintroduced.

nodes.label: nullableNumericString LLM-output validation
nodes.rationale: A non-numeric quantity from the LLM would fail the whole bulk insert at the numeric column; field-level validation at the external-API boundary is warranted.

nodes.label: F6 Slack + email weekly digest
nodes.rationale: Independent per-channel try/catch recorded in background_runs.stats; lesson: verify .env instead of repeating stale plan-doc cautions.

nodes.label: F7a coverage dashboard (Redis read-model)
nodes.rationale: Reuses FaqClusterService unchanged for chat-metric clustering; Redis over a new table to honour the no-migration classification.

nodes.label: FaqClusterService greedy clustering
nodes.rationale: Pure greedy single-pass cosine clustering, reused by F4 auto-FAQ and F7a topic gaps.

nodes.label: F5 comparison intent detection (classifyComparisonIntent)
nodes.rationale: Detect comparison from question text instead of a multi-select UX; separate 0.35 threshold vs CONFIDENT_MIN_SCORE; DuckDbQueryService single-table method delegates to N-table method.

nodes.label: F4 auto-FAQ from ticket clusters
nodes.rationale: findUncoveredTickets added beside findGaps (additive); FAQ approval reuses scrape.processor document-creation pattern; PII mitigated via extracted fields.

nodes.label: S2 scheduler substrate + F3 freshness detector
nodes.rationale: First Bull repeatable job (FreshnessTickProcessor); embedding-distance via LATERAL cosine join chosen over LLM-compare for zero new LLM cost.
nodes.norm_label: s2 scheduler substrate + f3 freshness detector

nodes.label: Docker platform: linux/amd64 pin
nodes.rationale: ARM64 gap only affected local Apple Silicon builds; VPS builds natively on x86_64; pin removes ambiguity.

nodes.label: DuckDB sandbox hardening (enable_external_access one-way lock)
nodes.rationale: Spike verified DuckDB refuses to re-enable external access; keyword DDL/DML filter still required; bigint results sanitized to Number.

nodes.label: drizzle-kit emits invalid quoted vector(1536)
nodes.rationale: Generated pgvector column type must be hand-fixed to unquoted form in migrations.

nodes.label: S3 chat_query_metrics telemetry
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget write raced tests; switched to await write().catch(); nullable embeddings skip exact-cache hits.

nodes.label: Post-login redirect fix via router.refresh()
nodes.rationale: Logged-out prefetch of /chat cached a middleware redirect in Next Router Cache; refresh invalidates it before push.

nodes.label: Retry-on-401 refresh inside apiFetch
nodes.rationale: Standalone fetch to /api/auth/refresh in client.ts avoids a circular import with auth.ts.

nodes.label: ReactBits/shadcn registry component vendoring
nodes.rationale: ShinyText needs motion, Strands needs ogl, SplitText needs gsap; vendored files lacked default React import; jsdom polyfills in vitest.setup.ts.

nodes.label: Missing 'use client' surfaced only by next build
nodes.rationale: image-tile.tsx used hooks without directive; first Server Component consumer (PillarShowcase) exposed it; Vitest cannot catch RSC boundary bugs.
nodes.norm_label: missing 'use client' surfaced only by next build

nodes.label: Orphaned dark: utilities fire on OS prefers-color-scheme
nodes.rationale: App dark tokens scoped to a .dark class nothing applies; stray dark: classes react to OS media query in isolation.
nodes.norm_label: orphaned dark: utilities fire on os prefers-color-scheme

nodes.label: ogl Renderer null WebGL context crash
nodes.rationale: new Renderer() throws when getContext returns null; try/catch in Strands.tsx wrapper; test stubs getContext to null.
nodes.norm_label: ogl renderer null webgl context crash

nodes.label: procps needed for nest start --watch tree-kill
nodes.rationale: tree-kill shells out to ps; Debian-slim dev image lacked procps, crashing API on every file change.
nodes.norm_label: procps needed for nest start --watch tree-kill

nodes.label: DuckDB per-file read_csv_auto type inference (COALESCE BIGINT/VARCHAR)
nodes.rationale: Each CSV inferred independently; cast sku/description to VARCHAR at CTE boundary; ALL_VARCHAR rejected because chat SQL needs numeric inference.
nodes.norm_label: duckdb per-file read_csv_auto type inference (coalesce bigint/varchar)

nodes.label: Global AllExceptionsFilter with requestId
nodes.rationale: Fixing observability first turned a blind 500 into a one-line diagnosis; SqlExecutionError maps to 503 with cause preserved.

nodes.label: Demo seeder lives at repo root (scripts/seed)
nodes.rationale: @repo/ai depends on @repo/db, so a seeder in packages/db importing @repo/ai would be a dependency cycle.
nodes.norm_label: demo seeder lives at repo root (scripts/seed)

nodes.label: Catalog item photo route + proxyRaw
nodes.rationale: photoStorageKey was inert until GET .../catalog-items/:itemId/photo and a Next proxyRaw route existed; a schema field is not a feature until something reads it.

nodes.label: DuckDB native binding: Node 22 pin is install-time only
nodes.rationale: duckdb.node is N-API; node_abi only keys the node-pre-gyp download URL, so failures are a fetch miss not an ABI mismatch; verify-env.sh reports reinstall risk.
nodes.norm_label: duckdb native binding: node 22 pin is install-time only

nodes.label: e2e failures: three stacked causes
nodes.rationale: Hook timeout, Bull job theft, incomplete jest.mock of @repo/ai; fix the outermost dumb failure first before A/B-testing.

nodes.label: BULL_PREFIX per-process queue isolation
nodes.rationale: prefix: process.env.BULL_PREFIX || 'bull' keeps production keys identical while isolating parallel jest workers.

nodes.label: S0a compare integrity: SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock + ParseUUIDPipe
nodes.rationale: Transaction gives atomicity, not isolation; row lock orders concurrent compares; class-level UploadExceptionFilter swallowed non-upload 400s.
nodes.norm_label: s0a compare integrity: select for update row lock + parseuuidpipe

nodes.label: S0b parse retries: classify input vs world failures
nodes.rationale: Input errors fail once without retry; others rethrow; reconcile requeues with fresh jobId suffix because Bull returns existing job for same id.
nodes.norm_label: s0b parse retries: classify input vs world failures

nodes.label: S0c TokenMeter + UsageService.metered
nodes.rationale: Optional meter keeps chain return types stable; charge in finally because provider bills the request; budget exceeded is a final job outcome.

nodes.label: S0d CI gate as a job inside deploy.yml
nodes.rationale: workflow_run executes default-branch workflow copy; needs: ci within one file is the contract; build @repo/db and @repo/ai before type-check.
nodes.norm_label: s0d ci gate as a job inside deploy.yml

nodes.label: Production runs Bun, not Node (node symlink spoof)
nodes.rationale: oven/bun image symlinks node to bun and reports v24.3.0; B11 retired, new risk: CI tests Node 22 while production runs Bun.
nodes.norm_label: production runs bun, not node (node symlink spoof)

nodes.label: xlsx pinned via cdn.sheetjs.com URL dependency
nodes.rationale: Clears CVEs of abandoned npm 0.18.5 but bun.lock records no integrity hash and CDN becomes a build-time dependency.
nodes.norm_label: xlsx pinned via cdn.sheetjs.com url dependency

nodes.label: S0f catalog search delete scoped to open/matchType/vendor
nodes.rationale: The defect was delete scope, not atomicity; empty SKU+description prefilter sent arbitrary items to paid vision model.
nodes.norm_label: s0f catalog search delete scoped to open/matchtype/vendor

nodes.label: Raster-only image allowlist (SVG XSS guard)
nodes.rationale: Serving the true stored image/svg+xml type inline would enable stored XSS; decide which truths are safe to serve.

nodes.label: S1 append-only comparison_runs
nodes.rationale: Stop deleting on re-compare; current = latest succeeded run; engine delta changed to match the seed; NULL-run fallback avoided a data migration.

nodes.label: S2 append-only discrepancy_decisions audit
nodes.rationale: Legacy PATCH dismiss writes an authored system note; outcome kept out of flag status enum to avoid ALTER TYPE; actor role looked up and stored.

nodes.label: S4 source document download as attachment + nosniff
nodes.rationale: Copy the KB download (octet-stream, attachment) rather than getItemPhoto; hasSourceFile boolean instead of exposing storageKey.
nodes.norm_label: s4 source document download as attachment + nosniff

nodes.label: Shared Content-Disposition filename sanitizer module
nodes.rationale: Deduplicated two copies from documents.controller.ts and tickets.controller.ts into one tested module.

nodes.label: S3a line-item provenance columns (source_row, uom, confidence)
nodes.rationale: source_page dropped because it cannot be filled honestly; skipEmptyLines turned off so row index maps to file line; uom alias excludes 'units'.
nodes.norm_label: s3a line-item provenance columns (source_row, uom, confidence)

nodes.label: S3b multipart @Body with FileInterceptor + currency normalization
nodes.rationale: IsISO4217CurrencyCode is case-insensitive so values normalized in service; UploadExceptionFilter condition is Array.isArray(body.message); list split into listPurchaseOrders/listInvoices.
nodes.norm_label: s3b multipart @body with fileinterceptor + currency normalization

nodes.label: S5 switch + assertUnreachable exhaustiveness for ProcurementDocKind
nodes.rationale: Guard only covers discriminated sites; ProcurementParseService.reconcile per-table scans needed a manual goods-receipt scan; isEmptyLineItem dropped quantity-only GRN rows.
nodes.norm_label: s5 switch + assertunreachable exhaustiveness for procurementdockind

nodes.label: S6 three-way comparison: empty grn.csv broke every comparison
nodes.rationale: Papa.unparse([]) yields no header, read_csv_auto builds zero-column table, Binder Error on mk; empty case is a structural requirement of a fixed query template.
nodes.norm_label: s6 three-way comparison: empty grn.csv broke every comparison

nodes.label: S6 uom_mismatch and currency needs-review flags
nodes.rationale: uom_mismatch outranks numeric branches; unstated unit is not a different unit; engine over demo seed showed the seed was wrong.
nodes.norm_label: s6 uom_mismatch and currency needs-review flags

nodes.label: Absent is not a value (NULL is not zero or different)
nodes.rationale: One rule governing accepted quantity, uom and currency columns in comparisons.
nodes.norm_label: absent is not a value (null is not zero or different)

nodes.label: S7 offset pagination needs a total order (desc id tiebreak)
nodes.rationale: All flags in one run share created_at from now(); ordering by created_at alone breaks LIMIT/OFFSET; current-run filter moved into SQL.
nodes.norm_label: s7 offset pagination needs a total order (desc id tiebreak)

nodes.label: S7 decision API had zero callers; RolesGuard never tested
nodes.rationale: listDiscrepancyDecisions/recordDiscrepancyDecision exported with no callers; e2e 403s only came from WorkspaceMemberGuard outsiders.
nodes.norm_label: s7 decision api had zero callers; rolesguard never tested

nodes.label: S8 goods receipt status='done' guard in compare()
nodes.rationale: Failed parse left stale rows contributing low accepted quantities; lifecycle field checked on some siblings not others; automation is a magnifier.
nodes.norm_label: s8 goods receipt status='done' guard in compare()

nodes.label: S8 auto-compare idempotency key must identify the input
nodes.rationale: Freshness compares against started_at, includes strategy_version and receipts; fixed delayed Bull jobId would swallow changes, so id carries newest input updated_at.
nodes.norm_label: s8 auto-compare idempotency key must identify the input

nodes.label: S8 derive lists from workspaceEventTypeEnum.enumValues
nodes.rationale: Hand-copied lists and ?? type / default fallbacks fail silently in front of users; comparison_flagged name chosen because enum values cannot be dropped.

nodes.label: S9 CASE label must not select stored evidence (price columns)
nodes.rationale: toFlagValues read price aggregates only for price_mismatch label, hiding price changes on quantity-mismatch lines.
nodes.norm_label: s9 case label must not select stored evidence (price columns)

nodes.label: drizzle-kit 0.20 silently drops partial index .where()
nodes.rationale: Generated plain unique index would reject superseded price terms; invariant moved into VendorPriceTermsService.create as sole writer; read emitted DDL.

nodes.label: S9 contract price flags computed outside the CASE ladder
nodes.rationale: Independent finding cannot live in a first-match classifier; runs over PO lines not engine rows; contract_unit_price column instead of reusing invoice_value.
nodes.norm_label: s9 contract price flags computed outside the case ladder

nodes.label: S9 vendor price history refuses to average
nodes.rationale: Units and currency are never converted, so avg is a claim about an undefined population; exceptionSummary returns zeroes not empty object.
nodes.norm_label: s9 vendor price history refuses to average

nodes.label: AI workflow port (TDD guard + gate, persona generator)
nodes.rationale: Runner parses Jest/Vitest JSON reports; gate base worktree runs bun install --frozen-lockfile instead of symlinking node_modules to avoid faking a RED.
nodes.norm_label: ai workflow port (tdd guard + gate, persona generator)

nodes.label: B22 Backblaze B2: compose environment overrode env_file S3_ENDPOINT
nodes.rationale: environment: beats env_file:, producing ENOTFOUND optra-prod-objects.seaweedfs; B2 Write Only still allows deleteFiles; endpoint now ${S3_ENDPOINT:?}.
nodes.norm_label: b22 backblaze b2: compose environment overrode env_file s3_endpoint

nodes.label: UploadExceptionFilter never fired (PayloadTooLargeException)
nodes.rationale: FileInterceptor converts MulterError before filters see it; unit test fed a shape the real pipeline never produces.

nodes.label: Three test layers rule (check-test-layers.sh)
nodes.rationale: Every change ships unit + API e2e + Playwright tests for layers touched, enforced per commit in CI.

nodes.label: Fresh database per test run (flaky suites)
nodes.rationale: Removed order dependence but not a slow-on-CI volume test or assertions that could not fail.
nodes.norm_label: fresh database per test run (flaky suites)

nodes.label: Per-account auth limits: count the attempt first
nodes.rationale: Read-then-write limits fail under concurrency; Redis INCR and a single row-locked UPDATE; proven with parallel tests.
nodes.norm_label: per-account auth limits: count the attempt first

nodes.label: Graphify completer resolves semantic cache by live content hash
nodes.rationale: Look up current file_hash across all p{fingerprint}/ namespaces; enumerating a namespace replays stale drafts.
nodes.norm_label: graphify completer resolves semantic cache by live content hash

nodes.label: Approval is not verification
nodes.rationale: Design-agent pressure tests found corrections in already-approved plans (S7, S8).

nodes.label: Tests required for every layer touched
nodes.norm_label: tests required for every layer touched
